policy_objective_contract: Do NOT externally supply per-trigger objective from an evaluator. A strictly declared, hand-coded public mission-stage program reads original public mission, public carried-key cue and public current front; if not carrying a key, attempt learned carrying_changed; if carrying a key, attempt learned visible_door_state_changed. Only physically execute R12-selected action if its learned positive-effect probability is >0 and it agrees with the public source preconditions: currently facing public key uncarried, or currently facing closed/locked public door with public held key. Otherwise delegate physical movement to exact preexisting hand-written public collector. This is manually specified sequencing and movement, NOT learned mission parsing or general cognitive autonomy. Never read global source map, source private carrying or door state, source seed as policy feature.
true_source_roles: Train unchanged R11 and separately authored independent conventional on exact 1664 original DoorKey selected FIT action/outcomes via existing C30 FIT training. Seal source-native and conventional before new episodes. For each new original source FIT seed, launch all THREE arms from identical reset and public data, distinct real original env.step(action) per arm, no counterfactual fabricated state. Native R12 and independent control may learn only from the original 1664 FIT, no extra weight updates on new episodes. Keep equal public information and original public collector randomization/action budget as closely as possible. Count all true actions, observed pickup/door opening, source goal reward, objective referrals and abstentions, source route divergence and source policy events.
acceptance: Require actual original source legal 0..6 action outcomes and no unobserved objective leakage, equal original FIT/native/conventional learned-action receipt coverage; report whether native-selected local effects change end-to-end observed task score compared with collector, and whether conventional matches. Fail closed on loss of provenance, uncontrolled source owner drift, missing key/door transitions, or nondeterministic science. Non-native navigation and explicit mission stage supplied are strongly declared; no novel native architecture qualification even with success.
resource: Two independent complete original-source 3-arm processes with exact action/outcome hash and complete cold-restored R10/R11 learned models, source CPU/RSS/checkpoint bytes; no protected scientific promotion
governance: Independent Mass Research DRAFT. No modification to original Yggdrasil R3/R10/R11/R12 source or FORGE/CKB controller/paid APIs, no merges or ChatGPT Library uploads.
